<a id="wait_fire_to_start"></a>
### [`wait_fire_to_start`](../../../../src/game/wait_fire.asm#L15) `$53E3`

*routine*

When $b2 = 0, shows PRESS FIRE TO START and waits for FIRE or a timeout. Then clears the score and the collision latches.
$b2 <> 0 skips the text and the wait.

- **Called from:** [`$4169`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L26)
- **Reads:** [`fire_pressed`](../../memory-map.md#fire_pressed), [`press_fire_text`](wait_fire.md#press_fire_text), [`CIAPRB`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRB), [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`start_wait_timer`](../../memory-map.md#start_wait_timer), [`SPSPCL`](../../memory-map.md#SPSPCL), [`SPBGCL`](../../memory-map.md#SPBGCL)
- **Writes:** [`start_prompt_screen`](../../memory-map.md#start_prompt_screen), `$D8AB`, [`start_wait_timer`](../../memory-map.md#start_wait_timer), [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`score`](../../memory-map.md#score)
